errorCodes.meaning: A grant the request selects has a protected party — its member DID or its principal DID is a rootAdmin account — and the requester is not a rootAdmin. Nothing was revoked.
A member DID's record changed under concurrent writes too many times for the revocation to be committed, and no grant on it was revoked. Send the request again.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GrantId.description: A grant's identifier, chosen by the member DID's signer and carried in its grant statement; a UUID is RECOMMENDED. A mediator refuses a grant whose identifier is already on the member DID's record.
GrantId.title: GrantId

GrantRef.description: Identifies one stored grant and the two parties to it.

principal.description: The principal DID the grant delegates to.

GrantRef.title: GrantRef

MuxDid.description: A DID, carried verbatim and compared by exact string equality. Unlike the messaging family's `Vid`, never a hash: the mediator resolves it to verify a statement signed by it. For a member DID reached over TSP, the TSP VID is the DID itself.
MuxDid.title: MuxDid

Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/admin-revoke request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/admin-revoke/0.1#response.

remaining.description: How many stored grants still match the request after it, because `limit` was reached. Send the same request again to revoke them; `0` when none remain.

revoked.description: Every grant this request deleted, ordered by member DID, then principal DID, then grant identifier; their members are detached from every connection before this response is sent, and each principal's replay floor rises so the statements cannot be stored again.

unmatchedGrantIds.description: Requested grant identifiers that name no stored grant matching the request.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux Admin Revoke — response payload

schema.description: An administrator revokes stored mux grants of other accounts — those of a principal DID, of a member DID, or between the two, optionally narrowed to named grant identifiers — a bounded batch at a time. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

grantIds.description: With `member` only: only these grants of the member DID. A grant identifier is unique on its member's record alone, so it is never accepted without `member`.

limit.description: The most grants this request revokes; the responder's default is 500. Grants still matching afterwards are counted in the response's `remaining`.

member.description: Only grants on this member DID. At least one of `principal` and `member` is REQUIRED.

principal.description: Only grants delegated to this principal DID. At least one of `principal` and `member` is REQUIRED.
